text:
ana-sales: Quick kickoff — ACME wants a 2-week trial with their de-identified content + a small live connector. Can SEs confirm what we need to hand off and timeline? cc @tom-se @maria-csm

tom-se: Here's the checklist I need:
- sample payloads (500–1000 rows)
- S3 read-only bucket or presigned urls
- CIDR for VPC peering or VPN + egress IPs
- accept list for callback webhooks
I'll paste minimal IAM policy below.

tom-se: ```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::acme-trial-data/*"]}]
}
```

lee-security: Two things: 1) We need a completed security questionnaire before peering (I sent the doc to legal). 2) Redaction: if they can't provide de-id'd data we'll require tokenization + rows masked. What's the PII risk level?

ana-sales: They said data is 'customer support transcripts' with emails/phone numbers. They can do basic redaction but need guidance on patterns.

(edited) tom-se: We can provide a simple regex redaction guide and a scrubber script. Also recommend ingest to a dedicated S3 prefix + server-side encryption + KMS CMK. See quick config:
```bash
aws s3 cp --recursive ./sanitized s3://acme-trial-data/sanitized/ --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id <cmk>
```

maria-csm: Success criteria for the trial: 1) Latency < 400ms p50 on sample prompts, 2) avg response quality >= 4/5 on 20 eval prompts, 3) integration demo with webhook callbacks. Can we lock eval set now?

tom-se: I'll draft 20 prompts and a scoring rubric. ETA EOD tomorrow. For pricing: trial uses hosted credits; if they go to Dedicated within 30 days we can credit 20% of consumed hosted spend toward first month of Dedicated commit.

lee-security: Also note: if data residency required (EU), we need to host trial in eu-west-1 — confirm with ACME.

ana-sales: I'll confirm residency and send sample payloads tonight. @deploy-bot can you schedule a sandbox for eu-west-1 if needed?

deploy-bot: sandbox-request received: region=eu-west-1?pending_confirmation, size=small-gpu, expires=2026-04-05. I'll proceed when @ana-sales confirms.

maria-csm: Great — once samples are in and the SecQ is back we'll do a 1-hour kickoff demo. Thanks all :rocket:
